description: A dim, narrow cobbled street at night, lined with half-timbered houses with shuttered windows. A man in a wide plumed hat and dark cloak strides forward holding a long staff, with a second man beside him holding a flaming torch. A group of men in broad hats and cloaks, some with pikes or staves, follows behind. A hanging iron lantern glows above, and smoke drifts through the upper street. No visible text or frame; the painting fills the image edge to edge.
